vector_name: SPFM mid-range realistic - passes B fails C

sum_lambda_safety.note: total safety-related = SPF+RF+MPF_latent+MPF_detected+safe =30+20+80+70+300=500? For this vector we set total independently to 1000 FIT to include other unclassified parts; use 1000 as denominator per ISO tool convention

computation: Step1 sum_SPF_RF = 30+20=50 FIT. Step2 ratio = sum_SPF_RF / sum_lambda_safety =50/1000=0.05. Step3 SPFM = (1-0.05)*100% =95.0%. Step4 ASIL evaluation: B requires >=90% => PASS (95>=90). C requires >=97% => FAIL (95<97). D requires >=99% => FAIL. LFM not computed in this vector but for reference denominator =1000-50=950 FIT, latent 80 FIT => LFM= (1-80/950)=91.58% would pass D.
discriminates: Realistic mid-range where SPFM is in 90-97 window, discriminates B vs C boundary; exercises normal case where safe faults included in total
known_uncertainty: Denominator definition whether safe faults included; using 1000 as total safety including safe per some tool flows; if safe excluded, SPFM would be 50/700=92.86% still B pass C fail but number changes

vector_name: SPFM threshold-boundary exactly 90 percent - ASIL B edge
computation: Step1 sum_SPF_RF=60+40=100 FIT. Step2 ratio=100/1000=0.10. Step3 SPFM=(1-0.10)*100%=90.0%. Step4 Compare to thresholds: ASIL B threshold is SPFM>=90% => exactly at threshold => PASS (inclusive). ASIL C >=97% => FAIL. ASIL D >=99% => FAIL. This is the mandated THRESHOLD-BOUNDARY case.
discriminates: Tests calculator handling of exact equality for inclusive >= threshold; boundary between fail and B-pass; catches off-by-one with > vs >=
known_uncertainty: None for arithmetic; threshold value 90% for ASIL B is stable across ISO 26262 editions, but table numbering changes

vector_name: SPFM high-coverage degenerate - passes D at 99 percent
computation: Step1 sum_SPF_RF=5+5=10 FIT. Step2 ratio=10/1000=0.01. Step3 SPFM=(1-0.01)*100%=99.0%. Step4 ASIL D threshold >=99% => PASS_AT_THRESHOLD. ASIL C >=97% PASS, ASIL B >=90% PASS. For LFM: denominator=1000-10=990 FIT (if safe included) or 1000-10-500=490 FIT if safe excluded; using simplified denominator 990, LFM=(1-5/990)*100%=99.495% passes all LFM thresholds (B 60%, C 80%, D 90%).
discriminates: Degenerate high-coverage case with safe-fault-dominated total, exercises D threshold exact 99% and tests safe-fault handling ambiguity; also shows how small residual drives high SPFM
known_uncertainty: Whether safe faults should be removed from denominator for LFM/SPFM affects LFM by ~0.5%; SPFM itself unaffected by safe separation if safe included in total as done here

vector_name: FIT zero failures mid-range 0.7eV 55C use 150C stress 60pct CL
computation: Step1 Convert temps: T_use_K=55+273.15=328.15K, T_stress_K=150+273.15=423.15K. Step2 1/T_use=1/328.15=0.0030474, 1/T_stress=1/423.15=0.0023632 diff=0.0006842 K-1. Step3 Ea/k=0.7/8.617333262e-5=8123.83 K. Step4 exponent=8123.83*0.0006842=5.558. Step5 AF=exp(5.558)=259.3. Step6 Equivalent use hours = N*t*AF =100*1000*259.3=25,930,000 h. Step7 lambda_hat=chi2/(2*equiv_hours)=1.832585/(2*25,930,000)=1.832585/51,860,000=3.5336e-8 per hour. Step8 FIT= lambda_hat*1e9=35.336 FIT at 60% CL. If using AF=260 approx, FIT=35.24 FIT (difference due to rounding).
discriminates: Realistic mid-range HTOL vector with zero failures, exercises Arrhenius AF calculation and chi2 for r=0; typical magnitudes for qualification (tens of FIT)
known_uncertainty: chi2 value exact 1.832585 for 60% CL df=2 is exact via -2ln(1-CL); Ea=0.7eV is default but mechanism dependent; junction vs ambient temperature correction not included

vector_name: FIT threshold-boundary AF equals 1 when use equals stress temp
computation: Step1 T_use_K=423.15K, T_stress_K=423.15K. Step2 1/T diff=0 => exponent 0 => AF=exp(0)=1.0. Step3 Equivalent hours =50*2000*1=100,000h. Step4 lambda_hat=chi2/(2*100k)=4.60517/200,000=2.302585e-5 /h. Step5 FIT=2.302585e-5*1e9=23025.85 FIT at 90% CL. This demonstrates degenerate AF=1 case, high FIT due to small sample. This is THRESHOLD-BOUNDARY for AF semantics (AF>=1 required for acceleration).
discriminates: Boundary where stress equals use, AF=1, tests division by AF and handling of no acceleration; also tests high FIT output and confidence 90% vs 60% difference; unrealistic for qualification but validates edge logic
known_uncertainty: AF=1 is theoretical; in practice stress > use; chi2 4.60517 for 90% CL df=2 is exact -2ln(0.1)

vector_name: FIT with one failure - tests chi2 df=4

chi2_60_4.units: dimensionless, approximate chi2(60%,4) from tables; more precise 4.045

computation: Step1 T_use_K=328.15K, T_stress_K=398.15K. 1/T_use=0.0030474, 1/T_stress=0.0025116 diff=0.0005358. Ea/k=0.9/8.617333262e-5=10444.5 K. Exponent=10444.5*0.0005358=5.596. AF=exp(5.596)=268.8. Equivalent hours= N*t*AF=200*2000*268.8=107,520,000h. lambda_hat=chi2/(2*equiv)=4.044/(215,040,000)=1.8806e-8 /h. FIT=1.8806e-8*1e9=18.81 FIT at 60% CL with 1 failure. If chi2=4.045, FIT=18.81-18.82 range. Compare zero-failure case would have chi2=1.8326 => FIT=8.52 FIT, so one failure raises FIT ~2.2x.
discriminates: Tests r=1 path where df=2r+2=4 and chi2 lookup differs from r=0; exercises higher Ea=0.9eV for electromigration vs 0.7eV default; realistic larger sample
known_uncertainty: chi2(60%,4) value 4.044 is table-looked approximate; exact inverse chi2 depends on statistical library; Ea 0.9eV applicability for electromigration only

vector_name: TPP mid-range below threshold - gaming GPU
computation: Step1 TPP_INT8 =2*MacTOPS*bit_length=2*200*8=3200. Step2 Since no other bit length yields higher TPP, TPP=3200. Step3 Compare to 3A090.a: threshold 4800 or (1600+PD>=5.92). 3200<4800 so first prong fails. Step4 PD=TPP/die_area=3200/200=16.0 per mm2. PD 16.0 >=5.92 and TPP 3200 >=1600 => WOULD be controlled under second prong of 3A090.a (1600+ and PD 5.92+). To make true below-threshold example, need larger area: if area=800 mm2, PD=3200/800=4.0 <5.92 => fails second prong, so below .a. For this vector we keep area 200 to show PD triggers .a despite TPP<4800. Expected: TPP 3200 <4800 but PD 16 >=5.92 => controlled under 3A090.a.2. If area were 1000 mm2, not controlled under .a but controlled under .b (2400-4800 and PD 1.6+).
discriminates: Tests second prong of 3A090.a where PD matters despite TPP<4800; discriminates between area-sensitive control vs pure TPP; mid-range realistic GPU
known_uncertainty: PD definition uses die area; exact area measurement method may affect PD by ~5%; TPP formula constant 2 confirmed from Jan 2025 FR notice

vector_name: TPP threshold-boundary exactly 4800 - meets first prong
computation: Step1 TPP_INT8=2*300*8=4800. Step2 TPP_INT16=2*150*16=4800. Step3 max TPP=4800. Step4 threshold check: 3A090.a.1 requires TPP>=4800 => exactly at threshold => CONTROLLED (inclusive). PD=4800/100=48.0 >=5.92 also => CONTROLLED via second prong as well. This is THRESHOLD-BOUNDARY case: TPP lands exactly at 4800. If TPP were 4799, first prong would be NOT controlled. Step5 For .b: 2400-4800 range is exclusive of 4800 upper, so 4800 not .b, it is .a.
discriminates: Boundary test for inclusive >=4800 semantics; validates max across bit lengths yields same TPP; tests that exactly-at-threshold is controlled, not just above
known_uncertainty: None for formula; threshold 4800 is current per BIS Oct 2023 + updates; if BIS updates threshold, vector parameterization would need named constant

vector_name: TPP below all thresholds - low-end edge AI
computation: Step1 TPP=2*50*8=800. Step2 PD=800/100=8.0. Step3 Check 3A090.a.1: 800>=4800? NO. Check a.2: TPP>=1600 and PD>=5.92? TPP 800<1600 => NO. So NOT controlled under .a. Step4 Check .b first prong: TPP 2400-4800 and PD 1.6-5.92 => TPP 800 fails. Second prong: TPP>=1600 and PD 3.2-5.92 => TPP 800 fails. So NOT controlled under .b either. Result: below all ECCN 3A090 thresholds. Adjacent to threshold: if MacTOPS were 100 => TPP=1600 exactly at lower bound of .a second prong and .b second prong, would then need PD check.
discriminates: Degenerate low-performance case that is below all control thresholds despite high PD; tests lower bound 1600 threshold logic and that high PD alone does not trigger control without minimum TPP
known_uncertainty: Thresholds for .b (2400, 1.6, 3.2) are from Oct 2023 IFR as amended; if regulation changes, thresholds must be parameterized; die area for small edge chips may include non-processing area affecting PD
